egamers.name: EGamers.io — GTA 6 Trophy List: All 55 Trophies And Achievements

keengamer.name: Keeengamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

pushsquare.name: Push Square — GTA 6: Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.guide: Finish every other trophy on this list first; the Platinum unlocks the moment the 54th one lands. There is no separate task here, so use the Roadmap view to see what is still open and work the stages in order.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing with Jason and Lucia. It unlocks as the story starts and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1 by playing the main missions through. Story only — it pops at the end of the chapter.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Story only — keep playing the main missions and it unlocks at the chapter's end.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Story only — it pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4. Story only — the last chapter trophy before the finale.
trophies.name: Top of the World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. Story only — after the credits you keep exploring Leonida in free roam, so nothing is lost by finishing the story first.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Story only — it unlocks as part of the campaign.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. Story only — it unlocks as part of the campaign.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Story only — it unlocks as part of the campaign.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Story only — it unlocks as part of the campaign.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. Story only — it unlocks as part of the campaign.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Story only — it unlocks as part of the campaign.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist of 35 tasks: the story, 100 optional tasks, robberies, collectibles and activities. Open Progress, then 100% Completion, after the story to see what is left. You do not need literally everything — 15 of 18 card sets and 70 of 80 Challenges count, for example — so follow the Stages view instead of chasing every last item.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida: Stunt Jumps (130), Under the Bridges (202), Knife Flights (40) and Base Jumps (25) — 397 in total, so a little over half. Find them on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots, and track progress under Progress, Activities, Stunts.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once. Dip into anything new you pass — races, shooting ranges, fishing, arcades — and it counts the first time you try it.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges at Rodgers Ranch and Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and some stay locked until you meet their conditions — check the map entry for each one.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Some charge an entry fee. Find them on the map under Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeating one race does not count, so work through the race list under Activities, Racing. Most locations let you hire a car — watch its Rating, which you can raise with Mod Shop upgrades.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge: early on Cal asks for a Parrotfish over 2kg. Fish in the marked area with a rod — grab a boat if you do not have one — until you land one big enough.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Find an arcade machine, play a full game through to its end, and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand, ending with his final mission. Follow Andy's missions as they appear around Leonida until the strand closes.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand, ending with the mission Maritime Disputes.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand, ending with the mission Hometown Heroes.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Any eight qualifying strands count — finish the five named finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) and any three others.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand and his final mission closes it. Randy's Wish List vehicle locations help along the way.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand and his final mission closes it. Kitty Litter Lab locations help progress his quests.
trophies.name: Spin on This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. This is the one potentially missable trophy: after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia invites Jason to meditate on the balcony in Chapter 1 — accept and finish it before leaving Chapter 1, then work through the other 17 spots. A meditation only counts once the final zen animation plays. Track them under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Work through Bret's Target Deck hunting objectives — 15 in total for 100% completion — and this pops on a unique-animal hunt.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in Leonida — collect every card in any 3 sets. Cards can be sold at Pawn Shops and still count toward progress.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Scan 100 locations with the WAiNK app — hold Up to open it on the phone. Landmarks (31), curiosities (35) and sculptures (23), plus No Flusher tags, all count. Check Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges. View them under Progress, Challenges. 70 are needed for 100% completion, so this one comes on the way there.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Build the wanted level together, then break line of sight and get clear before it drops.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain three shop robberies inside one wanted run.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get inside one or scan it with WAiNK. It happens naturally through the story; check Progress, Vehicles to see what you have found.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Group enemies first, trigger Combat Focus, and chain five takedowns before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport and take off with it.
trophies.name: Catch Me if You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Expect heavy resistance getting in and out — plan your escape route before you climb in.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and guards, and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. Vaults open up properly in Chapter 4, when the optional mission That's Where The Money Is unlocks them; 8 vaults are needed for 100% completion.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Hit a truck on the road, crack it open, grab the cash and lose the heat.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and uncover the complete map. Drive, fly and sail into every corner until no fog is left on the map.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Work through the gang operations list — 39 operations in total for 100% completion.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar spot on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail while taking in the view.
trophies.name: In the Beginning...

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom front and keep going.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Steal the three key valuables at the alley and escape.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Train strength for both characters until each stat is maxed.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile. Keep committing crimes and activities that move the profile — it accumulates across the whole game.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy whose exact trigger is still being confirmed by the community — its description, "Second time's the charm", is the only official clue. Check the cited guides for the latest confirmed method before chasing it, and do not trust a single unconfirmed video.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock method. Check the cited guides for the latest confirmed method before chasing it — do not trust a single unconfirmed video.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl them over with a melee drive-by. Knock bowling pins over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle at the bowling alley.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Fence marked bills until the total hits $250,000 — the same total counts toward 100% completion.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Buy clothes, food and gear — anything counts; find shops on the map under Style.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties through the Vice City Real Estate app on the phone — $160,000 in total. Garages store registered vehicles for Scooter Bros delivery.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop. You need free parking spots — buy garages from the Vice City Real Estate app if you run out.
trophies.name: On the Spot
